main_menu.no_run.en: No expedition to continue. Start a new game first.

expedition.starting_legion_infantry_arch.zh: 初始兵力：一队步兵；其他部队与建筑通过后续选牌获得。
expedition.starting_legion_infantry_arch.en: Starting force: one infantry squad. Recruit troops and facilities through later rewards.

expedition.passed_en_route_to_the_first_.zh: 随首段行军经过 · 不单独选牌
expedition.passed_en_route_to_the_first_.en: Passed en route to the first battle · No separate card choice

expedition.complete_the_campaign_unite_t.zh: 完成本局远征 · 地中海成为内海
expedition.complete_the_campaign_unite_t.en: Complete the campaign · Unite the Mediterranean

expedition.choose_1_of_3_building_doctri.zh: 三选一：部队、建筑、强化或军令；每攻下3座城额外获得一次扩建。
expedition.choose_1_of_3_building_doctri.en: Choose 1 of 3 troops, facilities, upgrades or orders. Every 3 captured cities grant one extra camp tile.

expedition.choose_the_highlighted_first_.zh: 选择第一座目标城邦，以初始步兵出征。攻下城邦后获得第一轮选牌。
expedition.choose_the_highlighted_first_.en: Choose your first destination and march with infantry. The first card reward comes after victory.

expedition.opening_deployment_pending_re.zh: 首战部署尚未完成。返回部署，选牌并完成建造后自动开战。
expedition.opening_deployment_pending_re.en: Opening deployment pending. Return to deployment, choose a card and finish building to begin combat automatically.

expedition.battle_complete_open_view_rep.zh: 战斗已结束。点击右上角“查看战报”完成结算。
expedition.battle_complete_open_view_rep.en: Battle complete. Open View report at the top right to settle the encounter.

expedition.battle_suspended_select_back_.zh: 战斗已暂停。点击右上角“返回战场”继续。
expedition.battle_suspended_select_back_.en: Battle suspended. Select Back to battle at the top right to return.

expedition.building_placement_pending_re.zh: 部署尚未完成，返回军营放置或升级后继续远征。
expedition.building_placement_pending_re.en: Deployment pending. Return to camp and place or upgrade before traveling.

expedition.supplies_pending_return_to_ca.zh: 补给尚未领取。返回军营选择一张卡牌后继续远征。

expedition.supplies_ready_choose_your_ne.en: . Supplies ready. Choose your next destination.

expedition.s_secured_your_army_buildings.en: %s secured. Your army, buildings and permanent doctrines carry over.

expedition.victory_the_eagle_reaches_s_t.zh: 远征告捷。鹰旗抵达%s，地中海成为内海。

expedition.the_legion_is_ready_choose_s_.en: The legion is ready. Choose %s to begin the Mediterranean campaign.

settings.frame_limit_hint.zh: 立即生效并保存；实际帧率取决于设备性能。

settings.music_edits.en: Original audio files are unchanged. Playback adjusts levels, skips edge silence, and applies fades and loop transitions.
